decision: Selected the official federal building-address record EGAID 101671935 (Theaterstrasse 15c, 8400 Winterthur (BFS 230, canton ZH); EGID 201033691), served in WGS84 by api3.geo.admin.ch, as the project_locator. NorthC publishes this address for its operating data centre.
identity_bridge: NorthC page 'Datacenter Winterthur (Zürich)' (JSON-LD datePublished 2023-08-17, dateModified 2026-04-21): 'Adresse: Theaterstrasse 15c, 8400 Winterthur (Zürich)'; the data centre lies beneath the Turm Areal; total area 1,100 m2; total power 1.8 MW; designed to Tier III.

NorthC release of 20 March 2025 (historical context): NorthC officially opened its Winterthur data centre beneath the Turm Areal, about 1,100 m2 and 1.8 MW, its fourth data centre in Switzerland after Münchenstein (Basel) 1 and 2 and Biel (Bern).
NorthC post of 30 October 2026: NorthC's Swiss data centres in Münchenstein near Basel, Biel and Winterthur already form a network today, connected by a redundant 400 Gbit/s DWDM backbone.

The federal search returns one official address for Theaterstrasse 15c 8400 Winterthur (EGAID 101671935; sub-addresses 15c.1 and 15c.2 are shelters) linked to GWR EGID 201033691: an existing (status 1004) non-residential building of class 1263, built 2004, 1,909 m2 footprint, on parcel ST9584 (EGRID CH840820778451). The register does not name the occupant; NorthC places its facility beneath the Turm Areal, so the address point locates the operator-published access address, not the data hall.
